description: The wire calls of the Slen SDKs: which HTTP operation of the API's OpenAPI spec each public call makes, and which SDKs offer it. The key is the call as a caller writes it after the client, the same way in both languages (`operations.execute` is `slen.operations.execute(…)` and `$slen->operations()->execute(…)`; a method of the client itself has no dot). `operation` is `METHOD /path` as the spec writes the path; `sdks` names the SDKs that offer the call (`php`, `typescript`) — every call is in both. A public call that makes no request of the API (`webhooks.verify`, `webhooks.constructEvent`, and `flush` in TypeScript) has no line here: each contract test lists it in its `NOT_CALLS` with the reason. Both contract tests read this file and keep no table of their own: a row of the contract test of each SDK is a line here that names its SDK, and the other way round, and each call is driven to the method and the path its line names — with no spec, and against the spec where there is one. Both help slices copy `operation` onto their calls. The rules are in the AGENTS.md of each package.
